intro: Football is the most popular sport in Yemen, despite years of war.

chapters.title: Football
text: Yemen qualified for the Asian Cup in 2019 for the first time as a united country. The under-15 team won the West Asian Championship in 2021.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Traditional sports include camel racing and dancing with the jambiya dagger.

keyTerms.meaning: A curved dagger worn on a belt.

items.title: Yemeni League
items.subtitle: Football
items.text: Al-Ahli Sanaa and Al-Tilal are well-known clubs.
